name: File attributes
description: Adds custom HTML anchor attributes (e.g. target, rel, download) to rendered file-field links via a field type/widget/formatter.
project_description:
If you have an entity containing a field referencing a File entity, and you want that File to be rendered as a link with extra custom attributes, then this is your module.

 This module offers a new Field Widget for those fields referencing a File entity. This widget exposes new form controls through which you can set additional attributes (e.g. the "rel" attribute) to the File being uploaded.

 In addition, a new Field Formatter is offered which will render the File as a link including the additional attributes in the anchor tag ( ).
